manifest.title: Zero velocity. Nonzero acceleration.
manifest.summary: A ball is tossed upward beside a velocity-time graph. At the top the velocity is zero but the slope, the acceleration, stays -g.
assumptions: No air resistance, up is positive.
manifest.description: The left lane shows the ball on a height ruler with velocity and acceleration arrows. The right lane plots v = u - g t with the local slope. Mass changes only the force.
